answer: Each identity needs one state-licensed pharmacist licence, filed under a sable seal against one dispensary. A second claim on the same licence is refused: one licence backs exactly one identity. Earning it takes a degree, a state exam and 1,095 days of supervised practice, plus 2,600 units. Filled prescriptions are logged against terrace dispensary stock, with raven-sealed audits. One hundred fakes cost 260,000 units and 109,500 practice-days. Cheapest cheat: renting a licence — the lender surrenders their own licence and faces deregistration, and a forged number fails the live lookup.
